reason: Added after P01 first-build feedback exposed visually generic native text, over-regularized editorial modules and insufficient material/print character despite structurally valid Figma output.

fixedShortDisplayTextPolicy.rule: Short fixed display text may be image-generated or prepared display art when its visual treatment is part of the page identity. This permission is not limited to personal names.
fixedShortDisplayTextPolicy.sourceOfTruthRule: When the visible display is generated/prepared art, retain the approved exact string separately as native/source-of-truth data and QA the visible rendering against it.
preferNativeWhen: precision metadata where styling is not identity-critical
hardRejects: choosing generic native type solely because it is easier to edit
baking long or frequently changing copy into raster art
treating generated visible text as the authoritative factual source

editorialIrregularityPolicy.principle: Preserve authored local irregularity from the Visual Master; do not manufacture random messiness and do not normalize the page into UI components.
rules: Do not force equal heights, equal photo sizes, equal padding or equal icon alignment merely for component reuse.
When the Visual Master contains measured differences, preserve them or tune toward them during Reference Delta.
Do not assign arbitrary rotation formulas or random offsets. Any tilt/offset must serve the Visual Master or improve direct visual comparison.
Related modules may share publication DNA without sharing identical geometry.
hardRejects: randomized scrapbook rotation with no reference basis

tactilePrintFinishPolicy.principle: Use restrained tactile/print character to avoid flat digital/AI-sticker appearance, but never apply indiscriminate global grain.
allowedCharacteristics: subtle paper fiber or matte print feel
small local imperfections that support the visual master
avoidOn: real photographs unless part of an approved photo treatment
the entire page as a uniform noise overlay unless the Visual Master explicitly requires it
hardRejects: texture added merely to make output look less digital
visible compression/noise mistaken for tactile print quality
tactilePrintFinishPolicy.qa: Texture/material treatment must survive A5 readability and Reference Delta; if it becomes the first thing noticed, it is too strong.

acceptanceRule: These policies are evaluated during docs/rurubu-v30/FIGMA-EXECUTION-ACCEPTANCE.md. Structural QA cannot waive them when they materially affect the Visual Master.
